caption: The drawing features two rectangular sections displayed side by side against an off-white background. The left rectangle, labeled "FRONT," contains a stylized floral motif executed in shades of blue; it shows a large, central flower with petals, leaves, and additional floral elements branching upward and outward, all painted in blue hues on a grayish-blue background. To the right, the narrower rectangle is labeled "HANDLE" and displays a single, vertically oriented blue floral design, also painted on a grayish-blue background. The drawings are contained within simple rectangular outlines, and the object placements and composition suggest a design plan for a decorated object, with clearly labeled sections "FRONT" and "HANDLE" indicated in uppercase text below each relevant rectangle.
